svg.title: Preserved storage has no path to the live cache
svg.desc: Maintain a wide empty gutter between preserved storage and live cache. Its lack of a drawn transfer is a bounded depiction, not proof against every other continuity channel. Pin the sealed to its preserved state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
